en: I just finished wandering.
Eldrin is the only one in Elwynn Forest that I would call a tailor.  You can find him at the Eastvale Lumber Camp if you're interested in learning the profession.
Wait here, $n. Spybot will make Lescovar come out as soon as possible. Be ready! Attack only after you've overheard their conversation.
Another good day indeed.
Ugh... these pests keep me busy night and day! Haven't you seen them?$B$BI wish I could just jump down a pipe to get away from them...
Yes! I want more of that fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir!

Once the greatest gold production center in the human lands, the Dead Mines are now inhabited by the Defias Brotherhood, who have turned the dark tunnels into their private sanctum. It is rumored that the thieves have conscripted the clever goblins to help them build something terrible at the bottom of the mines - but what that may be is still uncertain. Rumor has it that the way into the Deadmines lies through the quiet, unassuming village of Moonbrook.
The Frostwolf Graveyard is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will capture it!
Where can I find crypt fiend parts, Leopold?
Let's give this a try...
It was the will of Ragnaros that Obsidion be built. Obsidion will destroy the Blackrock orcs of Blackrock Spire, uniting us with our bretheren in the fiery depths.

All is completed, young $c. Even as we speak, both the Horde and the Alliance are in the process of transporting all final goods for the war into Silithus near Cenarion Hold, which should be complete in less than a day. After that, the gong near the gates of Ahn'Qiraj can be rung, and the war will begin.
The stars will be in perfect form tonight!
%s's eyes glow red as he lights his dynamite and begins to cackle madly!
You'll find the Wind Rider Master in Orgrimmar.  Go north up the road to get there and ask an Orgrimmar Grunt for further directions.
%s points you to the Gizmotronic Apparatus.
You have gone to great lengths, stranger, and you have my appreciation. I promised to further your training, and now I shall keep that promise.
I will, Tirion.
What do you want?
Your soul is doomed!
You take care of yourself! I'm gettin' out o' here.
The burning of the Wickerman will begin in thirty minutes!  Come to the festival - located just west of the Undercity - and celebrate Hallow's End and our liberation from the Scourge!
Tark, what happened in there? You know yer better den dat! Blue team, you will get yours soon 'nuff!
These lands shall be cleansed!
The auction house can be found on the central spire of Thunder Bluff.  Search near the bottom of the Windrider's Tower. May your ancestors watch over you.
You'll find that goblin and his toy shop in the Valley of Honor.
%s begins rummaging through the apothecary's belongings.
It cold there! You go in Royal Quarter, talk to Grizzle Halfmane.
Show me where I can fly.
Avert your eyes, children. The bloodrage has taken over...
You will never wake the dreamer!
I think I see something.
I smell rogue.
The Outrunners' duty is to ensure the safety of those who travel across the plains of Mulgore. Those that would threaten the safety of the tauren homeland risk punishment at our hands.

Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.
In building of War Quarter on outer ring of city.
Three cheers for $n!  This land shall be ours once again!
My son's soul will find no comfort in this hollow victory, dragon. I will have him back. Though it takes a millennia, I WILL have my son back!

Hello!  And welcome!  I'm afraid my booth is not open... many repairs are needed...$B$BBut I am still bound by blood oath to put a smile on your face.  So please, smile, or I must cut off my hand and consume no living flesh until it regenerates...
